**Wrote 4.2.0 to [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

Of 380 commits, only one feature and ten fixes touch behavior. Everything else was dep bumps, refactors, tests, ci, and docs.

One real behavior change worth flagging to the team: expired tokens now return `401` instead of `403` — anyone coding around the old status gets surprised.

Next: sanity-check the allowlist and pagination-cursor fixes against their actual PRs before you ship, the log doesn't say which direction the old bug broke.
